title: Dynamic Motor Unit Recruitment Modeling for In-Vivo Active Volume Calibration
description: While anatomical MRI provides high-precision V_anat (379.89 mL), dynamic active volume V_active varies between 83.6 and 144.4 mL depending on pedal torque and cadence. Cycle 9 must design a formal synthetic confidence ensemble or multi-channel sEMG/T2* inversion protocol to bound V_active without ad-hoc constants.

title: PhysioNet Malaga Treadmill CPET (SRC-0074) License Conflict and Redistribution Conditions
description: A tri-fold licensing divergence was identified during the Cycle 11 data provenance audit: (1) empirical_datasets_cycle11.json inadvertently listed ODC-By v1.0 (inherited from ACTES); (2) the downloaded raw distribution archive contains LICENSE.txt specifying Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); (3) the official PhysioNet resource landing page (version 1.0.1, DOI 10.13026/7ezk-j442) specifies the PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0 and Data Use Agreement 1.5.0. Public storage and redistribution of raw CSV files are strictly conditioned on non-commercial academic research attribution. Clean dual-licensing clearance is NOT claimed, and this conflict remains tracked as an OPEN_ISSUE.

title: Multi-Joint Closed Kinematic Chain Power Transmission and Tendon Safety Gap
description: The transition from single-joint knee extension torque to whole-body multi-joint functional movements (squat, sprint, vertical jump) remains unmodeled. Single-joint specific tension (27.22 N/cm2) and isolated tendon S-N fatigue (-86.7% cycles) quantified in Cycle 19 (EXP-0059, EXP-0060). Dynamic co-activation across bi-articular muscles and rapid rate of force development (dF/dt > 15 kN/s) are prioritized for Phase VI (EXP-0061, DEC-0024).
resolution: Closed-chain 3-DOF sagittal leg-press equilibrium LP (EXP-0061) and multi-layer viscoelastic enthesis dF/dt / heterochrony models (EXP-0062) completed as MODEL_ONLY formulations. External empirical validation of bilateral isometric leg press remains DATA_BLOCKED (0/6 open cohorts admitted, NEG-0060). EXP-0087 admits a narrower open 110-degree force cohort; exact task and individualized geometry remain blocked. Model-vs-LOSO comparison inconclusive.

title: External active-only torque benchmark and missing antagonist observations
description: NEG-0044 reproduces weaker active bridge performance than sEMG in the original Bird cohort. E1 requires another cohort with directly recorded antagonist and agonist EMG, protocol groups, measured torque and subject-level normalization.
resolution: Resolved for isometric knee extension/flexion in Cycle 16 (EXP-0051): LOSO evaluation on 20 subjects proved uncalibrated antagonist sEMG acts as noise (p = 0.1426), while anthropometrics and angle kinematics dominate (M4 R2 = 0.6301). Dynamic isokinetic regimes remain open for E1-DYN.

title: Absence of open synchronized multi-region tendon morphometry and local strain datasets
description: EXP-0049 and NEG-0046 established that HYP-0010 is DATA_BLOCKED because no public repository contains participant-specific regional patellar tendon CSA paired with local segmental strain measurements (speckle tracking/MRI) under calibrated tendon load.
resolution: Partially resolved in Cycle 16 (EXP-0052): In vivo displacement and strain non-uniformity confirmed on Bogaerts (p = 1.17e-13). Cycle 19 (EXP-0060) calibrated the S-N fatigue response (B = 8.45) and quantified the +15% CSA adaptive compensation envelope. Full regional stress validation remains open pending synchronized 3D morphometry.

title: Lack of non-Copenhagen independent human adult MTJ transcriptomic cohorts
description: EXP-0050 and NEG-0047 demonstrated that third-cohort replication of the MTJCore myonuclear transcriptional program is DATA_BLOCKED due to lack of publicly accessible human MTJ datasets outside the original Copenhagen research group.
resolution: Clarified in Cycle 16 (EXP-0053): NEG-0044 provenance explained by vastus lateralis mid-belly mismatch; Oxford atlas (Cohen 2026) audited and determined to lack myonuclei. Replicating myonuclear MTJCore requires intact co-harvested myofiber-tendon specimens.

title: Lack of open 3D-ultrasound or transverse MRI sub-tendon cross-sectional morphometry datasets for mechanical stress validation
scope: Biomechanical tendon modeling and HYP-0010 full validation
description: Bogaerts (2017) confirmed displacement non-uniformity but lacked transverse CSA of individual sub-tendons. Validating mechanical stress distribution requires synchronized 3D ultrasound or axial MRI segmentation of individual sub-tendons.

title: Resolution of MTJCore Oxford Discovery Identity and Accession GSE130649
description: Cycle 15-17 proposed using Oxford Achilles Atlas (Cohen et al. 2026) as a third independent replication of MTJCore and proposed GSE130649 for muscle atlas analysis. Audited in Cycle 18: Oxford Atlas is the MTJCore discovery dataset (circular replication prohibited), and GSE130649 is mouse inner ear organoids. Both issues fully resolved and corrected.
resolution: Classified Oxford evaluation as INVALID_CIRCULAR_EVALUATION; closed MTJCore replication on Cohen et al. with STOP_NO_ADDED_SCIENTIFIC_VALUE; purged GSE130649 from scientific proposals.

title: Frozen Pennes initial-state/parameterization failure at light cycling and missing synchronized whole-profile cohort
description: EXP-0066 loses to persistence at 5 min with a fixed initial tissue state. No new source supports the joint 2700-s performance, movement control, tissue and post45 endpoints.
required_inputs: Measured pre-effort temperature/initialization, mechanical work and environment with held-out participants; separately, a synchronized multi-outcome cohort for the programme gate.

title: Scherpereel processed moment scale is inconsistent across source documentation
description: Source README and article table label moment Nm; published plotting code labels loaded moment Nm/kg with no visible scaling. Numeric scale cannot be promoted to physical moment or tendon gates until provenance is clarified.
required_inputs: Author processing or verified configuration specifying platform moment reference, COP transformation, axes and filters plus unnormalized versus normalized matched ID outputs; prospectively verify on independent participants.
progress: EXP-0082 reconstructs IK and ID; scale/mass is 1.089 for AB01 but 0.574 for AB02, so preregistered two-person gate not met. EXP-0083 shows scale/mass 0.990 and 0.952 if horizontal force-platform moments are zeroed; validity of this convention is unconfirmed. EXP-0084 gives held-participant scale/mass 0.734 and 0.893 under vertical-only assumption; both pass broad range but AB03 remains 26.6% from unity, convention unconfirmed.

title: EXP-0061 ignores its hip flexion input in posture kinematics
description: The model passes theta_hip_flex_deg but never reads it inside posture_kinematics; fixed hip-ankle chord direction and knee flexion define the chain. All 100/140 degree LP scenarios are numerically invariant to hip input 40–110 degrees. This cannot support an independent hip posture robustness or actual subject geometry claim.
required_inputs: Explicit trunk orientation, measured hip, knee, ankle and foot positions and task geometry; biomechanically valid force-length and moment-arm effects; held-participant forces and prespecified comparisons against simple baseline.
progress: EXP-0092 tests five fixed chord directions; model tendon gate remains pose dependent. This is not measured trunk-relative hip geometry. Candidate SRC-0092 raw data not located; SRC-0091 archive retention expired.

title: EXP-0061 double-counts a gravity derivative in hip moment
description: EXP-0089 verifies against central differences that the archived hip gravity term double-counts the shank-foot contribution to its own documented potential. Dependent force, tendon and coupled scenarios require controlled recomputation and versioned interpretation.
required_inputs: Versioned corrected model with independent derivative/force checks, full rerun of dependent scenarios, explicit planar geometry and held-out individual validation.
resolution: EXP-0090 rebuilds named computational force, tissue, sensitivity and thermal dependencies with the corrected hip gravity term, preserving historical inputs; post-hoc external comparisons, explicit posture geometry and independent validation remain open. EXP-0091 updates nominal force comparison on the already viewed Santos sample; paired intervals do not establish superiority, and exact geometry and independent validation remain open.

title: Archived chain friction-utilization diagnostic fails at zero friction
description: EXP-0061 divides by mu when reporting friction utilization, so zero friction crashes after LP solution. EXP-0093 uses an in-memory diagnostic-only guard and keeps the original LP constraints.
required_inputs: For a maintained model implementation, guard zero denominator, preserve undefined utilization as null and add regression checks for zero and positive friction; verify solver constraints independently.
progress: EXP-0093 records feasible mu=0 scenarios with unchanged LP constraints and independently checked residuals; archived original remains unchanged.

title: Differential fatigue-to-force response and feedback are not identified
description: EXP-0085 assumes identical fractional force reduction for baseline and strategy. EXP-0094 demonstrates that conditional gain under load depends on differential mapping and actual work remains below diagnostic requirement.
required_inputs: Synchronized individual baseline and candidate forces before/during/after equal actual work, power time series, task geometry, temperature and control condition; preregistered independent participant transfer and uncertainty; tissue deformation for fatigue damage.
progress: EXP-0094 brackets conditional alpha thresholds for maintaining 20% gain but alpha and D2-to-force mapping are not measured; no force-to-energy or thermal feedback validation. EXP-0095 tests transfer of upper-limb task duration on SRC-0093 but has no post-load force, so does not identify differential force-fatigue response. EXP-0098 provides limited measured local torque recovery but no actual work, candidate/reference comparison or unexposed stimulation control. EXP-0101 adds previously viewed published group torque timepoints under two cycling intensities; individual power and actual work require author data. EXP-0102 finds fixed nonzero D2 fatigue scenarios fit recorded constant-load power worse than persistence on a reused cohort, under first-minute demand proxy; no force or measured exact demand available. EXP-0103 decouples demand and a hypothetical capacity: constant-load fit improves versus old D2 but does not establish advantage over persistence; sprint predictions remain poor on reused cohorts. EXP-0104 finds large relative sprint-shape error even after empirical first-bout normalization across two previously viewed cohorts; normalization is not an energy-balanced correction. EXP-0105 evaluates a previously unused 12-person passive sprint cohort; normalized D2 advantage is uncertain and source power units plus actual initial state need confirmation. EXP-0106 adds an external paired endurance dataset with 80%-PPO target; cognitive conditions yield different times but are absent from D2 input. Its power threshold and observed cadence/voluntary failure differ. EXP-0107 shows that initial fixed-power threshold crossings arise with reduced internal demand and no instantaneous D2 deficit relative to that demand; separate external demand and observed capacity remain needed.

title: SRC-0094 lacks a documented follow-up body mass
description: In long-format outcome data baseline mass is duplicated into follow-up rows for all participants; equality of entries cannot establish equal body mass. EXP-0096 therefore reports directional profile only.
required_inputs: Individually linked actual post mass and measurement date, units, instrument precision and protocol; independent verification of assignments and outcome reliability before any matched-mass claim.
progress: Source dictionary labels Body_Mass_kg Baseline; no separate post variable was located in the main table.

title: SRC-0095 recovery data identity and mechanical units unresolved
description: EXP-0097 found 48 workbook Subject_ID strings against 32 metadata participants, no within-file ID across both conditions, frequently fractional repetition fields and TW values 7.6–30.6 with dictionary unit m/s. These observations require source explanation, not an assumption of error.
required_inputs: Pseudonymous subject and session crosswalk, condition order, raw repetition counts and processing definitions, calibrated force, velocity and peak-power records with units and time stamps.
progress: Source and hashes checked; local request draft prepared but not sent. Quantitative admission is DATA_BLOCKED pending clarification.

title: SRC-0097 MVC trial aggregation does not reproduce published table under stated method
description: EXP-0099 finds the article-described best of three differs materially from published Table 1 while mean of the three supplementary values matches closely. Field mapping and processing must be clarified before interpreting the primary force endpoint.
required_inputs: Author mapping of Bp fields to trials, peak selection or averaging, unit conversion, inclusion and missingness rules and analysis-ready original script.
progress: Prespecified quality gate failed; predictive analysis held. A local author request is drafted and unsent; alternative mean is diagnostic only.

title: FORCE20 confirmation design lacks task-specific repeatability and justified effect margin
description: EXP-0100 shows power to establish a lower confidence bound above the 20% force contrast depends strongly on unmeasured task-specific variability and assumed true margin; the boundary itself cannot yield high power for a strict superiority test.
required_inputs: Independent test-retest force and body mass measurements in the actual multicondition protocol, control change-score variance, target contrast and confidence coverage, independent joint-outcome thresholds and preregistered prospective analysis.
progress: Scenario computed from published single-joint MD95, not a leg-press calibration or actual sample-size recommendation.
